title: Meeting
description: Scheduled business meeting or conference event. Tracks meeting details, organizer, participants, timing, location (physical or virtual), and current status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the meeting record

title.description: Subject or title of the meeting

description.description: Detailed agenda, topics, or purpose of the meeting

organizer.description: Full name of the person organizing or leading the meeting

start_time.description: Scheduled start date and time for the meeting

end_time.description: Scheduled end date and time for the meeting

location.description: Physical address or venue where the meeting takes place (if in-person)

type.description: Type of meeting (e.g., team meeting, client call, conference, workshop, one-on-one)

attendees_count.description: Total number of expected or confirmed attendees

status.description: Current status of the meeting (e.g., scheduled, in-progress, completed, cancelled, postponed)

online_link.description: Video conference URL or online meeting link (e.g., Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the meeting was created or scheduled
